units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 24a:8">M. Kat. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>כל ע׳ שאינה כעֲטִיפַת וכ׳</he> a covering which is not like the covering of the Ishmaelites (up to the lip) is not a mourner’s covering.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:7:8">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵇ</cite> top <he>כעֲטִיפָתֵנוּ בחול וכ׳</he> as we dress on week days, so do we on the Sabbath (we have no change of cloaks); <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:12">Ruth R. to III, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:2">Gen. R. s. 11</cite>, beg. <he>ברכו בע׳</he> he blessed it (the Sabbath) with the distinction of a special cloak; Yalk. ib. 16.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>שינו עֲטִיפָתָן וכ׳</he> changed their (Jewish) cloaks in days of persecution; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 136">Yalk. ib. 136</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 263">Yalk. Is. 263</cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:9:1">Cant. R. to V, 9</cite> <he>מלך בשר ודם מעֲטִיפָתוֹ ניכר</he> a human king is distinguished by his cloak. Treat. Der. Er. Zuta ch. V <he>בארבעה … ובעטיפתן</he> by four things are scholars recognized … by their cloaks; a. e.
